newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens firmer, lifted by strong Dow, bonds.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens firmer, lifted by strong Dow, bonds.

text.p: The FTSE 100 started the last session of a record-breaking week with moderate gains after a strong finish for U.S. stocks and bonds.
The index was 20.8 points up at 4,702 by 0751 GMT.

Dealers and strategists said the market was in a flurry of activity ahead of the 0930 GMT expiry of FTSE options and the index looked likely to stay around 4,700 and then drift off towards a more cautious close.
"There's nothing big until next Tuesday's FOMC meeting and the market will be biding time for the next two days," said Dresdner Kleinwort Benson strategist, Philip Isherwood.
